Done — T4 solved on the first execution.

**What the script does** (`out/T4/solution.py`):

1. Opens all three checkpoints lazily — the base through `model.safetensors.index.json` (sharded), ft1/ft2 as single files — behind one small `Checkpoint` view so shard layout is invisible to the merge.
2. Verifies key sets match across all three, that the 48 expected MLP names are present, then checks each of the 66 non-MLP tensors for identical shape/dtype and bit-exact equality (`torch.equal`) against both fine-tunes; any mismatch aborts before anything is written.
3. Merges each MLP tensor as `b + 0.4*(t1-b) + 0.4*(t2-b)` in float32, with both task vectors taken against the base tensor as read from disk (the base view is never mutated, so no ordering hazard).
4. Asserts exactly 48 merged and 114 output tensors, writes `out/T4/model.safetensors`, then re-opens the file and re-checks the count and key set.

Run output: `verified 66 non-MLP tensors identical in all three checkpoints` / `merged 48 MLP tensors, wrote 114 tensors`, in ~16 s. Self-report is at `out/T4/REPORT.md`.
